item.title: Mount Everest Climbers Will Soon Be Required to Pay a $4,000 ‘Clean-Up Fee’
item.description: Mount Everest is famous for its beauty, majesty, and the sheer amount of garbage on its upper reaches. Nepalese authorities are trying to change that.

item.title: Telluride Says ‘Snowmaking Operations Are Underway’ as It Refines Safety Plan for Reopening
item.description: Telluride Ski Resort released a statement regarding snowmaking operations, and how it is refining its safety plan amidst a ski patrol strike.

item.title: Gabriel Medina and Longtime Sponsor Rip Curl Are Splitting Up
item.description: For nearly two decades, Gabriel Medina has been a Rip Curl guy. But in 2026, the world champion and the the iconic brand will no longer be working together.

item.title: Ben Gravy Reflects on a Decade of Sobriety and the Tragic Loss of His Unborn Son
item.description: Ten years ago, Ben Gravy decided to quit drinking. His life improved immeasurably, but tragedy struck in July of 2025. Still, his message is a hopeful one.

item.title: 40 Killed in Bar Fire During New Year’s Celebration at Swiss Ski Resort
item.description: A New Year's celebration turned into a deadly inferno at a Swiss ski resort, when a fire tore through a nightclub, leaving 40 dead and 115 injured.

item.title: Gondola Accident Leaves Woman Hanging Upside Down by Ski Boot
item.description: At Park City Mountain’s Canyons Village, a skier's boot became trapped in a gondola door, leaving her dangling upside down until park staff could free her.

item.title: 4 Classic Post-Surf Meals
item.description: Surfers are not all the same. Across the coasts we dress differently, we listen to different music, and most notably, we crunch on different food post surf.

item.title: Saltwater Crocodiles ‘Surfed’ Their Way Around the Indo-Pacific Region
item.description: Saltwater crocodiles are incredible creatures. They'vespread themselves all over the Indo-Pacific region, even though long distance swimming isn't their forte.

item.title: Ben Ferguson Goes Absolutely Wild in the Backcountry in ‘CINDERS’
item.description: Ben Ferguson decided a few years ago that he'd like to focus more on backcountry riding. In CINDERS, a new snowboarding film, he does just that.

item.title: Seal Beach Resident Identified as One of Three Hikers Found Dead on Mt. Baldy
item.description: Casanova's body was found Monday with two other hikers whose identities the department has not shared yet. He reportedly fell 500 feet near Devil's Backbone.
